description: Add a location, post or digital human to the connected account's favorites, optionally with category, tags and note. item_type is location / post / digital_human; post and digital_human must actually exist. Favoriting the same item twice is not an error.

category.description: Custom category, e.g. "Must go", "Want to go", "Food", up to 50 characters

item_id.description: Object id (post id, digital human id, or a custom identifier for a place)

item_name.description: Display name shown in the favorites list, such as a place name or a post excerpt

tags.description: Tag array, up to 10 tags, each up to 20 characters

name: add_favorite
title: Add to Favorites
